asm_ida_com:
push    rbp
mov     rbp, rsp
mov     [rbp+spos], rdi
mov     rax, [rbp+spos]
mov     eax, [rax]
add     eax, 1
mov     ecx, 2Bh ; '+'
cdq
idiv    ecx
mov     rax, [rbp+spos]
mov     [rax], edx
mov     rax, [rbp+spos]
mov     eax, [rax+4]
add     eax, 1
mov     ecx, 2Fh ; '/'
cdq
idiv    ecx
mov     rax, [rbp+spos]
mov     [rax+4], edx
mov     rax, [rbp+spos]
mov     eax, [rax+8]
add     eax, 1
mov     ecx, 33h ; '3'
cdq
idiv    ecx
mov     rax, [rbp+spos]
mov     [rax+8], edx
mov     rax, [rbp+spos]
mov     eax, [rax+0Ch]
add     eax, 1
mov     ecx, 35h ; '5'
cdq
idiv    ecx
mov     rax, [rbp+spos]
mov     [rax+0Ch], edx
mov     rax, [rbp+spos]
mov     eax, [rax+10h]
add     eax, 1
mov     ecx, 3Bh ; ';'
cdq
idiv    ecx
mov     rax, [rbp+spos]
mov     [rax+10h], edx
pop     rbp
retn
